Why the weighted form holds for members in Turns, stated in rest.md: the history at k + j has the same law under the hybrid's draws before j. At position j the act's law moves by E|D(k + j, h)|, and later members, reading only the history and their own unchanged draws, cannot raise the TV (data processing). Summing over the hybrids gives the bound. At pairs differing in one draw this gives equality, which is why the smallest gap is 0 in every row.
